summary: Study ISO/IEC 20000-1 SMS requirements in a two-day PECB Foundation course with practical examples, exercises, quizzes, and exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This ISO/IEC 20000 Foundation course is designed for people who support, operate, manage, or improve service management processes and need a grounding in ISO/IEC 20000-1 requirements.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO/IEC 20000:2018 Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB Certified ISO/IEC 20000:2018 Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics. PECB lists no professional experience, management system audit or assessment experience, or service management system project experience requirement for this credential.
